reuse_policy: Reference and comparison only. No upstream skill text, code, fonts or private guide PDFs are vendored. Check file-specific licenses before copying upstream materials.

repositories.decision: Use as an official discovery reference; author small local document/data workflows. PDF rendering review and notebook reproducibility are relevant. Browser automation and deployment skills are not installed for exam use.
Compare evidence-led debugging and verification concepts; use shorter original task-specific skills without importing its entire workflow or approval requirements.
Reference UI clarity, meaningful states and visual review principles only. No Claude runtime or model integration; task functionality and exam restrictions take priority.
Use as a discovery index and example of versioned provenance. Review catalog entries rather than deploying a registry server or installing all bundled skills.
Reference the separation of how-to, reference and explanation. Do not import a mandatory outline-approval loop for a timed task.
Reference UI review routing. Its live external guideline fetch is not required by this offline playbook; review actual task UI and explicit local checks.
